title: Quality audit of OpenStreetMap buildings in Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh

headline.label: of 4,313 OpenStreetMap buildings in Dhanmondi, Dhaka with a geometry issue

service.name: Spatial Data QA/QC and Accuracy Checks

data: OpenStreetMap building ways and multipolygon relations in the box 90.3700 to 90.3880 E and 23.7380 to 23.7520 N (285 ha), read through the Overpass API on 21 November 2026 (database state 2026-11-20), © OpenStreetMap contributors, licence ODbL (openstreetmap.org/copyright).
method: Downloaded every building way and multipolygon relation in the box and kept those whose inside point falls in it.
Built polygons from closed ways and from the outer and inner rings of relations; 0 unclosed building ways could not form a polygon and were set aside.
Ran Madar Quality Checker on the layer in EPSG:4326 with osm_id as the unique identifier, addr:street as a required attribute and overlaps under 1 m² ignored.
Counted invalid, duplicate and overlapping geometry, empty identifiers and missing street names, and measured how many buildings carry a specific type and a number of levels.
limits: The audit checks the consistency of the open layer, not its truth on the ground: a footprint can be valid and still misplaced, outdated or missing. OpenStreetMap is edited by volunteers and changes daily, so these counts describe the stated database state only. Many buildings in a real place have no street address at all, so a missing addr:street is a gap for an address project, not always an error.
